source: Actual Electron development launcher + real Windows directory picker; no dialog interception
steps: Electron GUI is visible after launch (windowsHide:false).
Choose directory opens the actual Windows native folder picker.
Navigate to isolated Chinese-named test directory via the address bar and confirm Open Workspace.
Renderer displays the normalized directory, stable workspace ID and last verified readable/writable state.
Open the actual picker again and cancel; current workspace ID and directory remain unchanged.
limitations: Native keyboard automation uses type_text; physical Chinese IME composition is not manually verified.
CI Electron uses a deterministic fixture for the OS dialog return value; main/preload/auth/daemon are real.
No installer is built; browser standalone workspace actions remain deferred.
